mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 1.5 million persons triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting economic overheating concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative return when PAYEMS crosses threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as balanced economic activity enhances market confidence.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window, or 20d returns not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in unemployment (UNRATE below 3.5%) signals labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, 20d returns not significantly positive when UNRATE falls below 3.5% (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) combined with strong demand (GDPC1) create a positive feedback loop, generating S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate growth.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 are below their 5-year averages over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in supply (INDPRO) above 105 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting market optimism about abundant goods.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant return when INDPRO crosses threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) combined with strong labor demand (PAYEMS >1.5M) create a positive signal for S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors anticipate growth and employment stability.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS <4.5% and PAYEMS >1.5M over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE <4%) and ultra-easy monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <4.5%) signal a robust economic rebound, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery regime, 20d returns not significantly positive when both UNRATE <4% and FEDFUNDS <4.5% over the horizon.
